sections.Profile:
The "Tournament" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in August 1955, is a two-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1955
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Wood Rail, Medieval, Original Theme, History
